1) / BLOCK_X;\n    const size_t by = (ny + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y;\n    const size_t blocksXY = std::max<size_t>(bx * by, 1);\n\n    // Split z into chunks so there are enough blocks to fill the GPU while\n    // keeping chunks long enough for register reuse along z.\n    const size_t targetBlocks = (size_t)numSMs * 16;\n    size_t numChunks = std::max<size_t>((targetBlocks + blocksXY - 1) / blocksXY, 1);\n    numChunks = std::min<size_t>(numChunks, std::max<size_t>(nz / 8, 1));\n    numChunks = std::min<size_t>(numChunks, 65535);\n    l.zChunk = (nz + numChunks - 1) / numChunks;\n    if (l.zChunk == 0) l.zChunk = 1;\n    numChunks = (nz + l.zChunk - 1) / l.zChunk;\n    l.grid = dim3((unsigned)bx, (unsigned)by, (unsigned)std::max<size_t>(numChunks, 1));\n    return l;\n}\n\nvoid stencilIteration(const Real* d_input, Real* d_output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                      const StencilLaunch& l) {\n    stencilKernel<<<l.grid, l.block>>>(d_input, d_output, nx, ny, nz, l.zChunk);\n}\n\n'''\nsrc=src[:start]+new+src[end:]\n\nold_main=src[src.index('    // Allocate grids (double buffering)'):src.index('    // Calculate performance metrics')]\nnew_main='''    // Allocate device grids (double buffering)\n    Real* d_grid1 = nullptr;\n    Real* d_grid2 = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid1, std::max<size_t>(gridSize, 1) * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid2, std::max<size_t>(gridSize, 1) * sizeof(Real)));\n    // grid2 starts zero-initialised, as with std::vector\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_grid2, 0, gridSize * sizeof(Real)));\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(d_grid1, gridSize);\n    \n    const bool nonEmpty = gridSize > 0;\n    const StencilLaunch launch = makeStencilLaunch(nx, ny, nz);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    if (nonEmpty) {\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n            if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n                stencilIteration(d_grid1, d_grid2, nx, ny, nz, launch);\n            } else {\n                stencilIteration(d_grid2, d_grid1, nx, ny, nz, launch);\n            }\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - 1ull : 0ull)) << 52) | 0xC000000000000ull;\n    unsigned long long resBits = qBits;\n    if (rMag > threshold) {\n        resBits = awayFromZero ? qBits + 1ull : qBits - 1ull;\n    }\n    return __longlong_as_double((long long)resBits);\n}\n\n'''+s[e:]\nopen('stencil3d.cpp','w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build build 2>&1 | grep -E \"error|warning\"; for a in \"-x 128 -i 10\" \"-x 100 -y 37 -z 61 -i 7\" \"-x 256 -i 20\" \"-x 2 -y 5 -z 9 -i 3\" \"-x 3 -i 1\" \"-x 50 -i 0\" \"-x 300 -y 7 -z 200 -i 5\" \"-x 128 -i 101\"; do echo \"$a\"; diff <(./build/stencil3d $a -r -v | grep -vE \"time|Perf\") <(/tmp/ref/ref $a -r -v | grep -vE \"time|Perf\") && echo SAME; done; ./build/stencil3d -x 512 -i 100 | grep -E \"time|Perf\""},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3060,"cache_read_input_tokens":30053,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3060},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"07fcbdc8-2d91-4067-9e6e-97bea1b329a7","uuid":"52fccc40-36bb-4984-ad8c-05727bac47dd","timestamp":"2026-10-03T15:02:57.419Z","request_id":"req_011CffWLj1XXTyfb1WvVRo1s"}

1, lowEdgeEnd);\n                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, s.z0, lowEdgeEnd, s.edge);\n                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, highEdgeBegin, s.z1, s.edge);\n                if (sendDown) {\n                    const Slab& d = slabs[g - 1];\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyPeerAsync(d.buf[outBuf] + (s.z0 - d.zLo) * plane, d.device,\n                                                   out + (s.z0 - s.zLo) * plane, s.device,\n                                                   plane * sizeof(Real), s.edge));\n                }\n                if (sendUp) {\n                    const Slab& u = slabs[g + 1];\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyPeerAsync(u.buf[outBuf] + (s.z1 - 1 - u.zLo) * plane, u.device,\n                                                   out + (s.z1 - 1 - s.zLo) * plane, s.device,\n                                                   plane * sizeof(Real), s.edge));\n                }\n\n                // Interior planes overlap with the halo exchange\n                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, lowEdgeEnd, highEdgeBegin, s.compute);\n\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.computeDone, s.compute));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.edgeDone, s.edge));\n            }\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    for (Slab& s : slabs) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(s.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Gather the final grid (grid1 after an even number of iterations)\n    const int finalBuf = iterations % 2;\n    std::vector<Real> finalGrid(gridSize);\n    for (Slab& s : slabs) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(s.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data() + s.z0 * plane,\n                              s.buf[finalBuf] + (s.z0 - s.zLo) * plane,\n                              (s.z1 - s.z0) * plane * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(s.buf[0]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(s.buf[1]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(s.computeDone));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(s.edgeDone));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(s.compute));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(s.edge));\n    }\n'''\ns=s[:a]+main+s[e:]\ns=s.replace('constexpr int BLOCK_Y = 8;\\n','constexpr int BLOCK_Y = 8;\\n\\n#ifndef MIN_CELLS_PER_DEVICE\\n#define MIN_CELLS_PER_DEVICE (size_t(8) << 20)\\n#endif\\n')\nopen('stencil3d.cpp','w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build build 2>&1 | grep -E \"error|warning\"; for a in \"-x 128 -i 10\" \"-x 100 -y 37 -z 61 -i 7\" \"-x 256 -i 20\" \"-x 2 -y 5 -z 9 -i 3\" \"-x 3 -i 1\" \"-x 50 -i 0\" \"-x 300 -y 7 -z 200 -i 5\" \"-x 128 -i 101\"; do echo \"$a\"; diff <(./build/stencil3d $a -r -v | grep -vE \"time|Perf\") <(/tmp/ref/ref $a -r -v | grep -vE \"time|Perf\") && echo SAME; done; for x in 128 256 384 512 768; do ./build/stencil3d -x $x -i 100 | grep -E \"Perf\"; done","uuid":"2cd7c522-1e2e-4ef0-b200-418ae9a91770","session_id":"07fcbdc8-2d91-4067-9e6e-97bea1b329a7"}

iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n            const int inBuf = iter % 2;  // grid1 -> grid2 on even iterations\n            const int outBuf = 1 - inBuf;\n\n            if (numDevices == 1) {\n                const Slab& s = slabs[0];\n                launchStencil(s, s.buf[inBuf], s.buf[outBuf], nx, ny, nz, 0, nz, s.compute);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Dependencies on the previous iteration: own work done, and the\n            // neighbours' edge streams done (they read our staging buffers\n            // and read their halo planes that we are about to overwrite).\n            // All waits are issued before any event of this iteration is\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(s.hostHigh, out + (s.z1 - 1 - s.zLo) * plane,\n                                               plane * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s.edge));\n                }\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.sent, s.edge));\n\n                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, lowEdgeEnd, highEdgeBegin, s.compute);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.computeDone, s.compute));\n            }\n\n            // Receive halo planes from the neighbours\n            for (int g = 0;  // edge planes computed\n    cudaEvent_t edgeDone = nullptr;      // edge planes computed, staged and halos received\n''')\nrep('''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&s.edge, cudaStreamNonBlocking));''','''        int leastPriority = 0, greatestPriority = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange(&leastPriority, &greatestPriority));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(&s.edge, cudaStreamNonBlocking, greatestPriority));''')\nrep('''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&s.edgeDone, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&s.sent''','''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&s.edgeKernDone, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&s.edgeDone, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&s.sent''')\nrep('''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.edgeDone, s.edge));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());''','''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.edgeKernDone, s.edge));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.edgeDone, s.edge));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());''')\na=s.index('            // Dependencies on the previous iteration')\ne=s.index('            // Edge planes first (edge stream)')\ns=s[:a]+'''            // Dependencies on the previous iteration (all waits are issued\n            // before any event of this iteration is recorded):\n            //  - interior planes only touch owned planes, so they just need\n            //    the previous edge planes (RAW on z0 / z1-1, WAR on z0+1 /\n            //    z1-2);\n            //  - edge planes need the previous interior (RAW / WAR) and the\n            //    neighbours' halo receives (they read our staging buffers),\n            //    the own halo receive is ordered by the stream itself.\n            for (int g = 0; g < numDevices; ++g) {\n                Slab& s = slabs[g];\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(s.device));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(s.compute, s.edgeKernDone, 0));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(s.edge, s.computeDone, 0));\n                if (g > 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(s.edge, slabs[g - 1].edgeDone, 0));\n                if (g + 1 < numDevices) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(s.edge, slabs[g + 1].edgeDone, 0));\n            }\n\n'''+s[e:]\nrep('''                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, highEdgeBegin, s.z1, s.edge);\n''','''                launchStencil(s, in, out, nx, ny, nz, highEdgeBegin, s.z1, s.edge);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(s.edgeKernDone, s.edge));\n''')\nrep('''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(s.edgeDone));''','''        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(s.edgeKernDone));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(s.edgeDone));''')\nopen('stencil3d.cpp','w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build build 2>&1 | grep -E \"error|warning\"; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CffXEWG1hU113TXpCxGz2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The stencil now runs on the GPU with CUDA and spreads large grids across all available GPUs. Output is bit-identical to the original: across 12 test configurations, the Sum, Min, Max, Hash and sample values from `-r` all matched the reference build, and `-v` still passes. Only `stencil3d.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` were changed, and the executable is still `stencil3d`.\n\n**Performance (MCellUpdates/s, 100 iterations)**\n\n| Grid | Original CPU | CUDA |\n|---|---|---|\n| 128³ | ~420 | ~25,000 (1 GPU) |\n| 256³ | ~460 | ~57,000 (4 GPUs) |\n| 512³ | — | ~27,000 on 1 GPU → ~52,000 on 2 → **~99,000 on 4** (3.65×) |\n| 768³ | — | ~105,000 (4 GPUs) |\n\n**What changed in the code**\n- **Kernel:** each thread handles one (x, y) column and steps along z. The z-neighbours stay in registers, and z is split into chunks so the GPU stays fully busy. Boundary cells are copied in the same kernel, and the grid is initialised on the GPU.\n- **The real bottleneck was double-precision maths, not memory.** The RTX 3090 does double-precision arithmetic slowly, and a profile showed that, not memory bandwidth, was the limit. The slow part was dividing by 7.0, so I replaced it with a shorter sequence that rounds exactly like `x / 7.0` (a standard result known as Markstein's theorem). I checked it against `x / 7.0` on 1.4 billion inputs on the CPU, including the tricky cases near powers of two, with no mismatches. Zero, infinity, NaN and extremely large or small values still use the normal division. The six additions keep the original order, so rounding is unchanged.\n- **Multiple GPUs:** the grid is split along z, one slab per GPU. These GPUs can't copy directly to each other, so the one boundary plane each GPU needs from its neighbour goes through host memory each iteration. That copy runs at the same time as the main computation, and the CPU never waits inside the loop. Grids with fewer than about 4M cells per GPU stay on one GPU, because below that the copying costs more than it saves.\n- **CMake:** the `.cpp` file is compiled as CUDA, targeting the GPUs on the build machine, and builds in Release mode by default. `--fmad=false` and `--prec-div=true` are set so the compiler can't change rounding.\n\n**Things to be aware of**\n- **What the reported time covers:** like the original, it covers only the iteration loop, which now ends by waiting for the GPUs to finish. Copying the result back to the host happens after the timer stops.\n- **Varying runs:** before the final changes, runs at 384³ varied between about 25,000 and 49,000. After them, two runs gave about 87,000 and 88,000, but I didn't do more repeat runs to confirm it's stable.\n- **Two GPUs near the threshold:** just above the cutoff, using two GPUs is only slightly faster than one (about 27,100 vs 26,300 at 208³, and 29,900 vs 28,200 at 224³). The gain only becomes large at three or more GPUs.\n- **Choosing GPUs:** the program uses every visible GPU when the grid is big enough.
